## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

RaceListViewModel — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/racelist/RaceListViewModel.kt

## Trigger

Tapping a profile icon in the race list header, next to the "+" button — nothing observes it, the icon does not exist in RaceListHeader (RaceListScreen.kt)

## Today

`PhoneNavigator.toProfile()` exists and pushes `PhoneDestination.Profile`
onto the back stack, but no production code calls it — only
`PhoneNavigatorTest` and `MainActivityTest` exercise it directly.
`RaceListViewModel` injects `PhoneNavigator` and exposes
`onRaceClicked` and `onAddResultClicked`, the latter calling
`navigator.toPasteResult()`, but has no method for opening the
profile. `RaceListHeader`, in `RaceListScreen.kt`, renders only the
screen title (`PhoneStringResources.RaceList.title`) and the "+"
label (`PhoneStringResources.RaceList.addResult`), wired to
`onAddResultClicked`; it renders no profile icon.

## Expected

`RaceListHeader` renders a profile icon next to the "+" button.
Tapping it calls a new `RaceListViewModel.onProfileClicked` (mirroring
`onAddResultClicked`), which calls `navigator.toProfile()`. The icon
needs a user-facing symbol: no `PhoneStringResources.RaceList` entry
and no `strings.xml` key exist for it today — `race_list_add_result`
is the closest precedent, holding the "+" glyph as text, since the
screen renders no Compose `Icon`/`ImageVector` anywhere in
`app-phone`. A matching key (e.g. a profile glyph, following the same
text-glyph convention as "+") has to be added to `strings.xml` and
exposed through `PhoneStringResources.RaceList` for the header to
render.
